description: Land Title Settlement Department -Hardgalegama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511200
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration, specifically the declaration of determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and property rights/encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it focuses on land registration and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
